Settings

Appearance

Choose how PayAviator looks. Dark mode automatically changes text and cards for easy visibility.
Easy keeps Home simple. Advanced shows the full dashboard with all of your numbers and shortcuts.

Default Bill Settings

These choices are automatically used when you add a new bill. You can still change any bill individually.

Calendar Display

Choose what appears on the calendar and how many months open by default.

Safety

Keep confirmations on to help prevent accidental deletion.

Notifications

Control bill and reminder alerts in the Android app.
Bill alerts can be scheduled from the due date itself up to 31 days early. Reminder alerts use the date and time saved on each reminder. Sound choices are previewed in the app and will fire while this page is open. When running as a normal browser/download page, Android controls notification sound and cannot wake this page after it is closed; exact closed-app alerts require the installed Android app notification bridge.

Android App Security

PayAviator uses your phone's lock. If asked for a PIN, enter the same PIN you use to unlock your phone. You can also use your fingerprint if your phone allows it. PayAviator does not see or save either one.

Save your current changes, download a backup, or restore a previous backup.

Let's get you set up

Answer a few quick questions so PayAviator can calculate your income, bills, spending, and what you have available. You can change everything later.

Your information stays on this device. Your core budget data stays on this device. Internet access is only used for features such as connected bank accounts. Backups are only created when you choose to make one.
How much detail do you want on your Home screen?

Choose the style that feels more comfortable. You can change this later in Settings → App Colors.

Setup 2 of 4

Tell us about your income

This gives PayAviator a starting point for paycheck projections. If your pay changes, you can edit it anytime.

Setup 3 of 4

Set your starting monthly amount

This is the amount PayAviator uses as the starting point for “Available Now” this month. Paid bills and spending come out of it, while refunds add money back.

You can leave this blank and set it later under Budget → Monthly Budget.

PIN Lock (optional)

PIN Lock uses the lock already on your phone.
PIN: use the same PIN that unlocks your phone.
Fingerprint: use the fingerprint already set up on your phone.
PayAviator never sees or saves either one.

Sign in to connect your bank

Bills, income and spending work without an account. Signing in keeps your bank connections private to you. Bills you add stay on this phone. Connected bank data is stored securely on our servers so it can sync.

or use email
PayAviator uses read-only bank access through Plaid. Your bank login never touches PayAviator. Privacy Policy

PayAviator

Connect your bank with Plaid

PayAviator uses Plaid to connect your bank with read-only access.

  • Your bank login goes to PlaidYou sign in to your bank on Plaid's secure screen. Your bank username and password go to Plaid, never to PayAviator.
  • What PayAviator storesAn encrypted bank token, your bank's name, the connection status, and the transactions synced from your bank. This is kept on PayAviator's servers and linked to your account.
  • You're in controlYou can disconnect a bank or delete your account at any time in Connected Accounts. That removes the data stored for it.

Learn more in the PayAviator Privacy Policy and Plaid's End User Privacy Policy.
